name: codexmax-orchestrator
description: The open agentic orchestration layer for governed multi-host tasks.

interface.longDescription: Orcastrata Max keeps one Parent task responsible for the outcome. It can select a compatible worker without model input, bind an exact model to an approved transport for one task, run explicit adversarial lanes, and apply provider-authored patches safely in an isolated worktree. Discovery, planning, routing, supervision, verification, and closeout remain available for advanced composition.
defaultPrompt: GitHub — Use $codexmax-orchestrator:codexmax-github for an explicitly governed workflow.
